prompt: I want to start a fresh LLM wiki. I just watched Karpathy's 'Intro to Large Language Models' talk — can you ingest the key concepts from it? Here are the main topics he covered: what LLMs are (next token prediction on internet text), how training works (pretraining vs fine-tuning), emergent capabilities at scale, tool use and system prompts, security risks (jailbreaks, prompt injection), and the future of LLM OS. Set up the wiki structure and create the initial pages.

assertions.text: index.md exists and lists all created pages
Source page created for the talk
All pages have YAML frontmatter with required fields
Each page has at least 2 outbound wikilinks
Wiki written to config-resolved path (mock env knowledgeBase.wikiDir), not elsewhere
No files created inside the skill directory or real C:/Users/Administrator/memory dirs
